procedure: Verify carrier, hinge, hub, both stop and pin load paths; accepted load factors and guarded test procedure before movement.
record: Approved drawings; signed calculation; rig restraint and exclusion setup

procedure: Measure crank force and turns through complete travel in both directions, including gravity reversal. Stop at intermediate positions.
record: Force versus angle; turns; time; drift; handle kickback; temperature

procedure: Test each pin separately for full engagement; observe direct flags. Measure release force under prescribed residual load.
record: Pin stroke; engagement depth; force; deliberate partial engagement response

procedure: Exercise loss of power, one release cable failure, incomplete pin seating and drive fault using approved fault-injection procedure.
record: Controlled support retained; no unintended motion; fault recognition; recovery route

procedure: Apply approved static/dynamic loads at tread corners with uneven ground and one foot unsupported.
record: Deflection; strain; reaction; residual set; pin/stop operation after load

stage: Stationary occupied mock-up after rig acceptance
procedure: Time from restrained seat through exit to ground; include crank setup, pins, both hands, gloves and dark conditions.
record: Separate preparation / cranking / lock / descent times; assistance; stumbles; exertion

procedure: Fit representative intended operators at their paired seat, suspension and footrest settings.
record: Measured stature and seated dimensions; belt fit; knee / shin / crown clearances

procedure: Exercise each left brake lever through real travel and force while restrained; operate traction, horn, stop and camera selector.
record: Reach without torso lift; interference; hand force; accidental actuation; labels

procedure: Check front and side windows, both camera images and warning annunciator in sunlight and night lighting.
record: Sight lines; head/eye movement; glare; legibility; monitor obstruction

procedure: Release restraint, move around seat and use both exits at all seat limits; include the 600 mm nominal cushion-to-floor difference.
record: Foot and hand transfers; clothing snag; head strike; clear opening; assistance

procedure: Mark ground grid at front and last coach. Place measured targets at 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10 and 20 m within the available test area.
record: Actual near cutoff; side blind regions; occlusions; target size and recognition

procedure: Repeat target observations in sun / backlight, dusk / darkness, wet lens and a documented contamination condition.
record: Recognition by target and distance; glare / IR reflection; cleaning effectiveness

procedure: Measure end-to-end latency using a time-coded event visible to camera and reference recorder.
record: Latency distribution; frame cadence; event and displayed image timestamps

procedure: Inject each feed disconnect, camera power loss, monitor power loss, frozen feed and link recovery with actual hardware.
record: Time to distinct failure indication; freeze detection; no stale image marked live; recovery behavior

procedure: Use longest intended consist and all planned disconnects; measure loaded supply and inspect moving joint cable routes.
record: Voltage at far camera; link quality; articulation clearance; strain relief; bend compliance

procedure: Verify image orientation and usable awareness in both directions at approved test speeds and turns.
record: Operator identification errors; missed targets; vibration; lag; visibility at curves
